newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE opens lower in wake of U.S. rate rise.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE opens lower in wake of U.S. rate rise.

text.p: UK shares opened mixed to lower on Wednesday after the U.S. Federal Reserve's widely anticipated decision to raise U.S. interest rates for the first time in more than two years.
The FTSE 100 leading shares index was 9.2 points lower at 4,261.5 by 0834 GMT. Decliners outpaced gainers by roughly four-to-one.
"The quarter point rise was well flagged and well handled this time around," said one trader. "The initial reaction was that the (U.S) market went better on relief that it was out of the way."
